item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report == [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]\\ncases=[\\n ({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),\\n ({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','attempts':0},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':True},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':-1},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':0},p,{'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':1},p,{'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':2},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'running','to':'done','attempts':'bad'},p,{'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),\\n]\\nfor r,pol,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n got=evaluate(r,pol)\\n assert got==want,(r,got,want)\\n assert r==rb and pol==pb\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
